observations: The inverted lantern hood is repaired and the177 modeled fitting/cloth/lantern/bearing prototypes pass finite positive-volume and edge checks.
Gable is now reddish timber rather than pale specular cream or black; exact photographic finish remains unaccepted.

Low view exposed a still-wrong inherited construction: fixed-u front rafters fan into the ridge, and generic front roof rafters duplicate the specialist rows. R05 removes the duplicate rows and gives actual fixed transverse stations with inner hip cuts.
